net.sourceforge.hunterj.jdbc

Class AbstractQueryHandler

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.sourceforge.hunterj.jdbc.AbstractQueryHandler
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    JdbcQueryHandler

    public abstract class AbstractQueryHandler
extends java.lang.Object
implements JdbcQueryHandler
    AbstractQueryHandler is the base JdbcQueryHandler class to be extended for JDBC query encapsulation. All JDBC code is implemented within JdbcQueryHandler.doQueryAndProcessResults(). 
     Statement stmt = getConnection().createStatement();
 ResultSet results = stmt.executeQuery(sqlQuery);
 while(results.next(){
         ...
 }
    No need for additional callbacks. No need to close any of the JDBC resources. All that is taken care of.

      • setHaltOnError

        public void setHaltOnError(boolean haltOnError)
        Description copied from interface: JdbcQueryHandler
        The haltOnError switch is initialized to true by default. It is used to determine if execution of a given set of JdbcQueryHandler instances will be halted in the event of an exception thrown by JdbcQueryHandler.doQueryAndProcessResults(). Users can set this switch to true to prevent termination of all queries if this query throws an exception.
        Specified by:
        setHaltOnError in interface JdbcQueryHandler
